title: callerya dorwardii
intro: Callerya dorwardii, commonly known as the Chinese foxglove or yin chen hao, is a plant species native to China and Southeast Asia, belonging to the family Polygalaceae. The health benefits of Callerya dorwardii include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve blood lipid profiles, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to promote cardiovascular health, reduce blood sugar levels, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. Bioactive constituents of Callerya dorwardii include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
